questions.verificationNote: Reject at d≥Re, not only d>Re; accept d=Ac.

why.before: When using a double sampling plan, after you take the first sample you will either accept the lot, reject the lot, or draw another sample. If d1 is greater than the rejection number value, then you reject the lot. If d1 is more than the acceptance number but less than the rejection number, then you draw another sample.
